commits.message:
A Table cell pays its padding before its content, so one too narrow for its padding draws blank, as Rich's does (rich-unfiled-791c.gxf4) (#469)

* A Table cell pays its padding before its content, so one too narrow for its padding draws blank, as Rich's does (rich-unfiled-791c.gxf4)

The width is divided over whole cells, padding included, and each cell is
measured and drawn through Padding, as Rich's _get_cells wraps it. The seat
and padding-level passes are gone; a column the width leaves no cell draws
as nothing between its dividers. table-squeeze.golden.txt pins Rich 15's
rows at every width from the frame to the content.

* A rowless Table column measures Rich's unpadded minimum, and the squeeze golden pins grid, width, noWrap and padding modes (rich-unfiled-791c.gxf4)

Review pass (high) on PR #469: an empty column's minimum is Rich's bare 1,
not 1 plus padding; the docs no longer say a sub-frame table draws bare
content; two stale comments follow the padded widths; the Rich-generated
golden now covers declared width, noWrap, collapsePadding, padEdge: false
and Table.grid.

* A Table too narrow for its declared widths cuts them evenly, as Rich does (rich-unfiled-791c.gxf4)

Review pass (medium) on PR #469: reservations were paid in column order, so a
second width: 6 column beside a width: 4 one drew nothing at width 9 where Rich
draws both. Reservations now go through reduceToFit's even cut, each held to
the width inside the frame first (Rich's with_maximum), and the squeeze golden
pins two declared widths at every width from 5 to 17.

* Table's width division drops reduceToFit's dead kept field and derives each column's padding once (rich-unfiled-791c.gxf4)

Review pass (escalation high) on PR #469: no wrapable column holds a
reservation, so kept was always 0; _cellRange takes the padding pair
_columnDemands already derived; the docs name reservations in the payment
order and claim only the even cut among them.
